# Pi-TUIX
> Open-source terminal UI extension for Pi Coding Agent with a clearer, denser workflow for long coding sessions.

Pi-TUIX is a presentation layer. Pi continues to own model requests, built-in tool execution, sessions, permissions, credentials, and provider integrations.

## Quick Start
- [README](README.md): Overview, local prototype setup, commands, compatibility, and roadmap
- [Product context](docs/product-context.md): User problem, MVP workflow, success criteria, and non-goals
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Public ExtensionAPI boundary and event-to-view rules
- [Positioning](docs/positioning.md): Product ownership and design principles

## Current Features
- Pi-TUIX header with model and workspace information
- Footer with model, context usage, and working directory
- Working indicator for active turns
- Reversible editor chrome with READY/WORKING and prompt size status
- Pi CustomEditor behavior preserved for history, autocomplete, paste, and shortcuts
- Compact Read, Bash, Edit, and Write rows with explicit state and attention labels
- Expandable ANSI-aware output and edit diff summaries
- `pituix`, `pituix-default`, and `pituix-about` commands
- Bundled `pi-tuix-dark` theme

## Planned Features
- Thinking, progress, token/context, approval, plan, queue, and session surfaces

## Compatibility
- Pi Coding Agent `>=0.84.0`
- `@earendil-works/pi-tui` `>=0.84.0` as a peer dependency
- Node.js `>=22.19.0` for local development
